newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rabobank German unit to be part of Dutch operation.
newsitem.headline: Rabobank German unit to be part of Dutch operation.

text.p: Dutch cooperative Rabobank on Wednesday confirmed reports it was transferring the assets of its independent Rabobank Deutschland AG unit to Rabobank Nederland.
"Rabobank Deutschland AG will become part of Rabobank Nederland and through them of Rabobank International, our wholesale operation," spokesman Jan Dost said.
He said the decision would enable the German operation to take advantage of the parent's Triple A credit rating.
The move would also mean a relaxation of the stiff solvency requirements the German operation had to meet.
"Moreover, there is no reason for continuing an independent Rabobank Deutschland in a single European market," Dost added.
